name: PDF Table Data Conversion
description: Extract tables from a PDF document (e.g. contract rebate or pricing schedules) and convert them into a clean, workable Excel spreadsheet or CSV.
author: Lewis Baybutt
coverImageAlt: A folded blank document passes through precision rollers and emerges as an orderly matrix of blank data tiles.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: A thick folded document with a table trapped inside passes through precision rollers and emerges as clean, separated rows and columns of physical data tiles ready for reuse.
Scene/backdrop: A compact document-conversion workbench on a slate field, with no screens or software controls.
Subject: One folded blank paper document, a central precision roller assembly, and an orderly set of unlabeled warm-paper data tiles.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding
Correction: Widen the view so the complete folded document, roller assembly, and finite output-tile matrix all fit inside the inner 84% with clear empty space around them; remove accessory trays and every edge-touching object, and keep all paper and tiles entirely blank.
